C1.evidence: CLI optional compatibility is explicitly separated from mandatory current prompt usage; uncollected input is not mistaken for a completed candidate.

C2.evidence: apply/chunk and R2/R3/R5 all share the candidate gate; final OUT1 matrix/foundation/basis checks remain.

C3.evidence: SKILL, prompts and question-bank/state-contract agree on pre-publication candidate validation and rejection preserving original state.

C4.evidence: Answer accumulation then candidate confirmation breaks the original grounding-confirmation dependency cycle using the same validator/catalog.

criterion_evaluations.text: validate-coverage-matrix.py が spec-state.json に対し 6 canonical platform 全存在・各セルが未収集/対象外/確定の3値・対象外に理由(または approval_ref)・確定に qa_ref・カテゴリ集約が真理値表一致・不正値0件を機械検証して exit0 になる。R0-foundation 完了後は --require-foundation も付け、requirements_foundation の U1-U9(値ありまたは明示 N/A・U1/U2/U3 は値必須)・decisions 契約・各確定セルの serves_goals トレースも exit0 で検証する(R0 完了前の foundation 未確定段階では --require-foundation を課さない段階条件)。加えて各確定セルの根拠 (qa_ref と qa_refs) のうち少なくとも 1 件が basis(user-decision/observed-fact/agent-inference) を宣言し、宣言がすべて agent-inference ではないことを --require-basis が exit0 で検証し、missing_effect=block の必須情報については confirm を含む writer apply/chunk を --required-info <catalog> 付きで実行し、既存 validate_required_info が候補 state の接地を確認してからだけ公開する(失敗時は元 state を変更しない。公開後は validate-knowledge-graph.py --profile required-info --state <spec-state> の coverage_certificate.ungrounded_blocking_items が空であることを再確認する)。
criterion_evaluations.evidence: Both apply and chunk mutate an in-memory candidate, call existing validate_required_info, then publish through _emit only after success. R2/R3/R5 require --required-info for confirm while answer-only turns can accumulate without it; question-bank step5 specifies retaining input and retrying held confirmation. The isolated CLI case proves first confirm after separate answer accumulation and byte-preserving rejection on a missing block item. Foundation/basis/matrix proof remains separate.

criterion_evaluations.text: 往復ヒアリングを経て全セルが確定または対象外(理由付き)で埋まり未収集0になった最終 spec-state.json を validate-coverage-matrix.py --require-complete --require-basis --require-foundation が exit0 で確認し(未収集0だけでなく、全確定セルの basis と U1-U9・serves_goals トレースまで最終条件に含める)、受入テストが resume 保存も含めて再現する。
criterion_evaluations.evidence: Current Purpose/OUT1 retain final --require-complete --require-basis --require-foundation and post-publication required-info validation. The candidate barrier fixes the precondition/postcondition cycle without deleting final U1-U9/serves_goals/six-platform/resume obligations. Current validator CLI wiring was inspected; full final-state/resume acceptance was not rerun here.

criterion_evaluations.text: 実対話のlive trialで、U1-U9確定、needs_guidance時の最新根拠付き2〜3案、free/low-cost候補、AI推奨保留、ユーザー確認、最終未収集0までを機密情報なしのsandbox stateで完走できる。
criterion_evaluations.evidence: R5 retains latest official evidence, 2-3 options including free/low-cost, pending AI recommendation before explicit user decision and neutral questions. Current set_decision checks option counts, cost axes, provenance, user confirmation and nonfuture timestamps. This static assessment does not conduct or accept the required live dialogue.
